list.name: platform_os
list.label: OS
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT platform_os FROM builds WHERE platform_os IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: platform_build
list.label: Build Type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT platform_build FROM builds WHERE platform_build IS NOT NULL AND platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: arch
list.label: Arch
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT arch FROM builds WHERE arch IS NOT NULL AND platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: branch
list.label: Branch
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(branch,'(none)') FROM builds WHERE platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: fork
list.label: Fork
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(fork,'(none)') FROM builds WHERE platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: test_suite
list.label: Suite
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT t.suite FROM test_results t JOIN builds b ON b.build_id=t.build_id WHERE t.status='fail' AND b.platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND b.platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: testname
list.label: Test
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT t.name FROM test_results t JOIN builds b ON b.build_id=t.build_id WHERE t.status='fail' AND b.platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND b.platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND b.arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) AND t.suite IN (${test_suite:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Failure matrix -- failing tests x builds
panels.description: Each row is a failing test in a build. Filter with the variables above; click Build/Test to open Jenkins. Time range filters on the build start time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.build_number AS "Build", t.suite AS "Suite", t.name AS "Test", t.worker AS "Worker", b.branch AS "Branch", t.failure_message AS "Error" FROM test_results t JOIN builds b ON b.build_id = t.build_id WHERE t.status = 'fail' AND $__timeFilter(b.build_ts) AND b.platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND b.platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND b.arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.branch,'(none)') IN (${branch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.fork,'(none)') IN (${fork:singlequote}) AND t.suite IN (${test_suite:singlequote}) AND t.name IN (${testname:singlequote}) ORDER BY b.build_number DESC, t.suite, t.name
